description: Two-year scholarship for incoming NC freshmen entering an ABET-accredited engineering program; awarded each spring.
eligibility_text: Incoming freshman intending to major in engineering in an ABET-EAC accredited curriculum; citizen and permanent resident of North Carolina; must remain in engineering with at least a 3.0 GPA after freshman year to keep the second year. The 2026 signature page certifies study at North Carolina State University.
